department: Labour Resources Department, Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB)
description: The 'Grant for Purchase of Tools' scheme is implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB), Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar. Under this scheme, registered construction workers who have successfully completed skill upgradation training are provided financial assistance of up to ₹15,000 for purchasing trade-related tools required for their work.
objectives: Provide financial assistance to construction workers for purchasing trade-related tools.
Encourage workers to complete skill upgradation training.
Improve the productivity and livelihood of registered construction workers.

benefits.title: Financial Assistance for Tools
benefits.description: Financial assistance of up to ₹15,000 is provided for purchasing trade-related tools after completion of skill upgradation training.

eligibility.title: Construction Worker
eligibility.description: The applicant should be engaged in building or construction work.

eligibility.title: Registration
eligibility.description: The applicant should be registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB).

eligibility.title: Active Membership
eligibility.description: The applicant's membership with the Welfare Board should be active at the time of application.

eligibility.title: Skill Upgradation
eligibility.description: The applicant should have completed any approved skill upgradation training.

registration_steps.title: Visit Official Website
registration_steps.description: Visit the official website of the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

registration_steps.title: Authenticate Aadhaar
registration_steps.description: Enter Aadhaar number and name, then complete authentication.

registration_steps.title: Submit Registration
registration_steps.description: Submit the registration form and pay the application fee online.

registration_steps.title: Receive Registration Number
registration_steps.description: Construction worker registration number is generated after successful registration.

application_steps.title: Login
application_steps.description: Visit the official website, click 'Login' and select 'Labour'.

application_steps.title: Verify Details
application_steps.description: Enter registration number and year of birth to view worker details.

application_steps.title: Select Scheme
application_steps.description: Choose the 'Grant for Purchase of Tools' scheme.

application_steps.title: Upload Documents
application_steps.description: Fill in the application form and upload all required documents.

application_steps.title: Track Status
application_steps.description: Track the application status online. Updates are sent to the registered mobile number.

documents_required.name: Skill Upgradation Training Certificate
documents_required.remarks: Proof of completion of skill upgradation training.

documents_required.name: Other Supporting Documents
documents_required.remarks: Any additional documents required by the department.

important_notes: Only registered construction workers with active membership are eligible.
Completion of skill upgradation training is mandatory.
Maximum financial assistance under the scheme is ₹15,000.
Applicants can track their application status online through the BBOCWWB portal.

faqs.question: Who can apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Registered construction workers with active BBOCWWB membership who have completed skill upgradation training.

faqs.question: What is the maximum financial assistance available?
faqs.answer: Eligible workers can receive financial assistance of up to ₹15,000.

faqs.question: Is skill upgradation training mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes. Only workers who have completed skill upgradation training are eligible.

faqs.question: How can I apply?
faqs.answer: Applications can be submitted through the official BBOCWWB portal after logging into the worker account.

faqs.question: Can I track my application?
faqs.answer: Yes. Application status can be tracked online, and updates are sent to the registered mobile number.
